```{r}
#| label: load dfs for results report
#| echo: false
#| output: false

library(dplyr)


# Raw Data
chla_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "chla_raw.rds"))

do_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "do.rds"))

sal_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "salinity_raw.rds"))

turb_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "turb_raw.rds"))

water_temp_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "water_temp_raw.rds"))

raw_data <- list(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = chla_raw,
  "Dissolved oxygen" = do_raw,
  "Salinity" = sal_raw,
  "Turbidity" = turb_raw,
  "Water temperature" = water_temp_raw
)

all_sites <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  raw_data,
  \(data, parameter_name) {
    tibble::tibble(
      parameter = parameter_name,
      Location_Identifier = data$Location_Identifier
    )
  }
)

length(unique(all_sites$Location_Identifier))
```

```{r}
#| label: load processed data sets for results report
#| echo: false
#| output: false

# Processed Data

chla <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "chla_proc.rds"))

do <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "do_proc.rds")) 

sal <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "sal_proc.rds"))

turb <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "turb_proc.rds"))

```

# Results

*Water Quality Observations*

Queried water quality observations for a twenty year period between 2005 and 2025 returned more than 25,000 observations from 174 unique sampling sites located within the PBS (@tbl-raw-data-summary). 

```{r}
#| label: tbl-raw-data-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of raw water-quality data available for each environmental parameter."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

raw_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  raw_data,
  \(data, parameter) {
    result_values <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(data$Result_Measure))
    )
    sample_dates <- as.Date(data$Activity_StartDate)
    reported_units <- unique(
      trimws(as.character(data$Result_MeasureUnit))
    )
    reported_units <- reported_units[
      !is.na(reported_units) & reported_units != ""
    ]

    tibble::tibble(
      Parameter = parameter,
      `Total Observations` = nrow(data),
      `Unique Stations` = dplyr::n_distinct(
        data$Location_Identifier,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      #`Numeric results` = sum(!is.na(result_values)),
      `Begin Date` = min(sample_dates, na.rm = TRUE),
      `End Date` = max(sample_dates, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Reported Units` = paste(reported_units, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(`Total Observations`)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Total Observations` = scales::comma(`Total Observations`),
    `Unique Stations` = scales::comma(`Unique Stations`),
    #`Numeric results` = scales::comma(`Numeric results`),
    `Begin Date` = format(`Begin Date`, "%m/%d/%Y"),
    `End Date` = format(`End Date`, "%m/%d/%Y")
  )

knitr::kable(
  raw_summary,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "c", "c", "l")
)
```

After processing and spatial aggregation, there were a total of `{r} sum(length(chla), length(do), length(sal), length(turb)) ` records each representing the mean value for that location (@tbl-processed-data-summary). Chlorophyll-a processing resulted in 754 observations summarized within 27 spatial bins using 48 stations. Dissolved oxygen had 3072 observations summarized into 68 bins across 145 stations. Salinity had 3,400 observations summarized into 67 bins with 135 stations, and turbidity retained 1563 observations within 61 spatial bins using 122 unique stations.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-processed-data-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of processed warm-season water-quality data used for spatial interpolation."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

processed_data <- list(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = chla,
  "Dissolved oxygen" = do,
  "Salinity" = sal,
  "Turbidity" = turb
)

parameter_units <- c(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = "µg/L",
  "Dissolved oxygen" = "mg/L",
  "Salinity" = "ppt",
  "Turbidity" = "NTU"
)

processed_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  processed_data,
  \(data, parameter) {
    tibble::tibble(
      Parameter = parameter,
      `Spatial bins` = nrow(data),
      `Unique Stations` = sum(
        data$n_stations,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      `Total Observations` = sum(
        data$total_n,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      `First year` = min(
        data$first_year,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      `Last year` = max(
        data$last_year,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Units = parameter_units[[parameter]],
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Spatial bins` = scales::comma(`Spatial bins`),
    `Unique Stations` = scales::comma(`Unique Stations`),
    `Total Observations` = scales::comma(
      `Total Observations`
    )
  )

knitr::kable(
  processed_summary,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "c", "c")
)
```

*Water Quality Mean Observation Data Distribution*

Mean Chlorophyll-a values ranged from `{r} round(min(chla$mean),2) ` to `{r} round(max(chla$mean),2)`ug/L with an average mean of `{r} round(mean(chla$mean),2)`ug/L. The distribution was heavily skewed to the right due to an extreme outlier of 60ug/L.

```{r}
#| label: fig-processed-mean-distributions
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of processed warm-season spatial-bin means for each environmental parameter. Dashed lines identify the median of each distribution."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

water_temp <- readRDS(
  here::here(
    "2-data",
    "processed",
    "water_temp_proc.rds"
  )
)

processed_data <- list(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = chla,
  "Dissolved oxygen" = do,
  "Salinity" = sal,
  "Turbidity" = turb,
  "Water temperature" = water_temp
)

parameter_units <- c(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = "µg/L",
  "Dissolved oxygen" = "mg/L",
  "Salinity" = "ppt",
  "Turbidity" = "NTU",
  "Water temperature" = "°C"
)

parameter_order <- names(processed_data)

parameter_labels <- paste0(
  parameter_order,
  " (",
  parameter_units[parameter_order],
  ")"
)

processed_mean_data <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  processed_data,
  \(data, parameter) {
    data |>
      sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        parameter = parameter,
        value = .data$mean
      )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    parameter = factor(
      parameter,
      levels = parameter_order
    ),
    parameter_label = factor(
      paste0(
        parameter,
        " (",
        parameter_units[as.character(parameter)],
        ")"
      ),
      levels = parameter_labels
    )
  )

processed_medians <- processed_mean_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(parameter_label) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_value = median(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  processed_mean_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = value)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(
    bins = 12,
    fill = "#2C7FB8",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    data = processed_medians,
    ggplot2::aes(
      xintercept = median_value
    ),
    color = "#B2182B",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~parameter_label,
    scales = "free_x",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Processed spatial mean",
    y = "Number of spatial bins"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

```
